title: 第5章 墓园异兽首杀立威第6章 三日苦修脱胎换骨
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 葬神墓园的夜，没有晨昏，不见日月。
浓稠如墨的黑雾沉沉压落，封锁整片山谷，将最后一丝天光彻底隔绝。刺骨阴风穿梭在林立的断碑残冢之间，呜呜嘶吼，像是万千不得安息的亡灵在耳畔低泣盘旋。遍地荒坟塌陷、乱石嶙峋，腐朽的泥土混杂着陈年血垢，空气里漂浮着化不开的阴冷死寂，压抑得人胸口发闷，寻常修士踏入此地，片刻便会道心紊乱、灵力溃散。
林寂稳坐一尊断裂的无字墓碑之上，身形挺拔，纹丝不动。
历经数个时辰的闭关吸纳与反复淬炼，他刚突破的引气入体境界愈发稳固。不同于普通修士根基虚浮、灵力浅薄，他依托墓园无尽朽气洗练身躯，每一丝修为都扎扎实实沉淀在丹田气海与经脉血肉之中，根基浑厚程度，远超同阶正统修士数倍不止。
青云宗绝大多数外门弟子，踏入引气境后，灵力运转生涩滞涩，催动基础功法都颇为吃力。可林寂周身流转的漆黑朽气，内敛沉凝、顺滑自如，顺着经脉周天循环往复，悄无声息淬炼着他的筋骨皮肉，让原本孱弱单薄的肉身，一日千里般飞速蜕变。
他缓缓抬手，指尖一缕细微的黑气流光一闪而逝。
没有正统灵气的璀璨光华，没有震彻四方的浩荡道韵，平平无奇，黯淡内敛，丝毫不会引人瞩目。
但唯有林寂心知肚明，这看似不起眼的朽气，藏着颠覆常理的恐怖力量。正统灵气滋养万物、渡化生机，而他的朽道之力，专克阴邪、腐蚀灵力、瓦解术法，拥有寂灭一切生机的霸道特性。
“难怪天道要将我体质封印伪装成朽体废根。”
林寂心底轻叹，眸底寒芒微亮。
这种不纳天地清灵、反吞万古腐朽的修行之路，彻头彻尾逆了诸天正统，是天道忌惮的禁忌之道。若是过早暴露，必然引来天地规则的疯狂反噬与宗门的极致打压。
蛰伏，依旧是当下唯一的生路。
正当他沉下心神，准备继续吸纳周遭朽气、深耕境界、夯实道基之际，一抹极细微的摩擦声，悄然从左侧坍塌荒冢的阴影深处传出。
声音极轻，被呼啸的阴风完美掩盖，寻常人根本无从察觉。
但觉醒归零残灵体后，他的五感早已被朽气极致强化，远超寻常修士，瞬间精准捕捉到了这缕藏在风声中的异动。
他双眸依旧紧闭，面上毫无波澜，周身流转的朽气瞬间尽数收敛，沉入丹田经脉深处。顷刻间，他身上所有修行气息消散无踪，又变回了那副身躯孱弱、死气沉沉的废人模样，完美隐匿在墓园黑雾之中。
死寂的墓园之中，异动愈发明显。
漆黑幽深的坟影里，两点幽绿冷光骤然亮起，悬浮在黑雾之中，阴森刺骨，裹挟着浓烈嗜血的凶煞之气，死死锁定静坐的林寂。
是噬煞兽。
林寂瞬间认出此物——墓园独有的噬煞兽。此兽常年盘踞葬地，以千年怨念、战死煞气为食，天生隐匿黑雾，身法诡谲迅猛，爪牙带剧毒，最擅长暗中偷袭活人。千年来，无数被发配至此的守坟弟子，大多惨死在噬煞兽的偷袭之下，是低阶修士谈之色变的绝境凶物。
咔嚓！
清脆的骨裂声骤然响起。
狂暴挣扎瞬间僵滞，噬煞兽四肢剧烈蹬踏，幽绿兽瞳中充斥着极致的惊恐与不解。它无法理解，这个被宗门弃入墓园、人人唾弃的废体少年，为何会拥有如此恐怖的肉身力量与反应速度。
林寂五指骤然收紧，掌心蛰伏的漆黑朽气轰然爆发，顺着兽颈皮肉蛮横侵入它的四肢百骸、本源核心。
content_en:
At night in the God Burial Cemetery, there is no dawn or dusk, no sun or moon.
The thick, ink-like black mist fell heavily, blocking the entire valley and completely cutting off the last trace of skylight. The biting cold wind shuttled between the broken monuments and tombs, whining and roaring, like thousands of undead souls that could not rest in peace, whimpering and circling in their ears. There are collapsed tombs and jagged rocks all over the place. The rotten soil is mixed with old blood and dirt. There is an inexorable coldness and deathly silence floating in the air. It is so oppressive that people feel tight in their chests. When an ordinary monk steps into this place, his Taoist heart will be confused and his spiritual power will collapse in a moment.
Lin Ji sat firmly on a broken tombstone without words, her body tall and straight, motionless.
After several hours of seclusion, absorption and repeated tempering, his newly broken-through realm of drawing Qi into the body became increasingly stable. Unlike ordinary monks whose foundations are superficial and their spiritual power is shallow, he relies on the endless rotten energy of the cemetery to refine his body. Every trace of his cultivation is solidly deposited in the sea of ​​Qi in his Dantian and the flesh and blood of his meridians. His foundation is many times thicker than that of orthodox monks of the same level.
Most of the outer disciples of the Qingyun Sect, after entering the Qi-Entraining Realm, their spiritual energy flow is jerky and stagnant, and it is quite difficult to activate the basic skills. But the dark decaying energy flowing around Lin Ji was restrained, calm, and smooth, circulating along the meridians and silently tempering his muscles, bones, skin, and flesh, causing the originally weak and thin body to rapidly transform with each passing day.
He slowly raised his hand, and a tiny stream of black air flashed across his fingertips.
Without the dazzling brilliance of the orthodox aura, without the majestic Taoist rhyme that shakes all directions, it is ordinary, dim and restrained, and will not attract anyone's attention at all.
But only Lin Ji knew that this seemingly inconspicuous decay contained terrifying power that subverted common sense. Orthodox spiritual energy nourishes all things and transforms vitality, while his power of decay is designed to overcome evil, corrode spiritual power, disintegrate magic, and has the domineering characteristic of extinguishing all vitality.
"No wonder Heaven wants to seal my body and disguise it as a rotten body and waste roots."
Lin Ji sighed softly in her heart, and the cold light in her eyes shone slightly.
This kind of cultivation path that does not accept the pure spirits of heaven and earth and swallows up the decay of the ages is completely contrary to the orthodoxy of the heavens and is a taboo way that the heavens are afraid of. If it is exposed prematurely, it will inevitably lead to a crazy backlash from the rules of heaven and earth and extreme suppression from the sect.
Hibernation is still the only way to survive at the moment.
Just as he was calming down and preparing to continue to absorb the decayed energy around him, cultivate his realm deeply, and consolidate his foundation, a very subtle friction sound quietly came from the depths of the shadow of the collapsed barren tomb on the left.
The voice was extremely soft, perfectly covered by the howling wind, making it impossible for ordinary people to detect it.
But after awakening and returning to the residual spirit body, his five senses had already been extremely strengthened by the decayed energy, far beyond that of ordinary monks, and he could instantly and accurately capture this strange movement hidden in the sound of the wind.
His eyes were still closed, and there was no wave on his face. The rotten energy flowing around his body instantly converged and sank deep into his Dantian meridians. In an instant, all the aura of cultivation on his body disappeared without a trace, and he returned to the appearance of a weak, lifeless man, perfectly hidden in the black mist of the cemetery.
In the dead silence of the cemetery, strange movements became more and more obvious.
In the dark and deep shadow of the tomb, two green icy lights suddenly lit up, suspended in the black mist. They were eerie and bone-chilling, carrying a strong and bloodthirsty aura, locking onto Lin Ji who was sitting in silence.
It's a beast that eats evil.
Lin Ji instantly recognized this object—the evil-eating beast unique to the cemetery. This beast has been entrenched in the burial ground all year round, feeding on thousands of years of resentment and the evil aura of those killed in battles. It is born to hide in the black mist, its movements are strange and swift, its claws and claws are highly poisonous, and it is best at sneaking up on living people in secret. For thousands of years, most of the countless tomb-guarding disciples who were sent here died tragically under the sneak attacks of evil-devouring beasts. They were dangerous creatures in desperate situations that low-level monks talked about with disgrace.
Click!
The crisp sound of bone cracking suddenly sounded.
The violent struggle suddenly froze, the evil-eating beast's limbs kicked violently, and the eyes of the dark green beast were filled with extreme panic and confusion. It couldn't understand why this young man with a useless body, who was abandoned by his sect and cast aside in the cemetery and despised by everyone, had such terrifying physical strength and reaction speed.
Lin Ji's five fingers suddenly tightened, and the dark rotten energy that had been dormant in his palm suddenly exploded, and invaded its limbs, bones, and core along the skin and flesh of the beast's neck.
title_en: Chapter 5: The first kill of the strange beast in the cemetery establishes its power Chapter 6: Three days of hard training and rebirth
